title: Arcane Trickery
summary: Arcane Trickery is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 15% chance to turn the Warframe invisible for a short time upon performing a Finisher kill.
extract:
Arcane Trickery is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 15% chance to turn the Warframe invisible for a short time upon performing a Finisher kill.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Hydrolyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Neptune Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

History
Arcane Trickery was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Trickery from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Trickery from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Trickery from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Trickery from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Trickery from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
Parazon Mercy kills will activate the effect.
Can be refreshed.
Will not work for  Mercy's Kiss on regular units, i.e. enemies who don't have parazon finishers.

Tips
The following Warframe abilities can trigger finishers
 Ash's  Blade Storm
 Oraxia's  Mercy's Kiss* See Notes
The following Warframe abilities can open enemies up to finishers
 Banshee's  Savage Silence
 Baruuk's  Lull
 Equinox's  Rest & Rage in Night Form
 Excalibur's  Radial Blind
 Gara's Passive
 Inaros'  Desiccation and  Sandstorm
 Ivara's  Quiver
 Lavos'  Ophidian Bite
 Valkyr's  Paralysis
The following Companions can trigger finishers:
 Medjay Predasite's  Infectious Bite and  Paralytic Spores
 Sunika Kubrow's  Savagery
 Sahasa Kubrow's  Ferocity
